grupoLima.title: Grupo Lima Project
grupoLima.description: Grupo Lima, established as the largest internet provider in rural Espírito Santo, needed a digital ecosystem that matched its size and credibility. Braxen stepped in to design the company's new website, combining aesthetics and performance.
grupoLima.body: The project was entirely designed with a conversion-first approach, using advanced UX/UI Design techniques to guide users seamlessly toward sign-up. Visually, the site was built to impress: an immersive interface that captures immediate attention, conveying the seriousness, robustness, and authority that Grupo Lima represents for thousands of connected users.

planoAssinatura.title: Subscription Plan
planoAssinatura.description: We developed a landing page focused on selling subscription plans, designed to turn visitors into recurring subscribers. Whether for premium meat clubs or craft beer subscriptions, the entire experience was built to spark desire and highlight the value of recurrence.
planoAssinatura.body: One of the main challenges of this business model is convincing customers that a subscription goes far beyond a one-time purchase. It requires conveying exclusivity, convenience, savings, and the experience of receiving quality-selected products without having to worry about new purchases every month.

arboreto.title: Arboreto Project
arboreto.description: We developed a landing page for a high-end custom furniture company with the goal of positioning the brand in the premium segment and conveying the quality present in every project.
arboreto.body: In the custom furniture market, many clients look for more than a good price: they seek trust, exclusivity, personalized service, and the certainty that they are investing in a company capable of delivering sophisticated and lasting environments. With that in mind, we created a digital experience that communicates these values from the very first visit.

cpfSemPendencia.title: CPF sem Pendência Project
cpfSemPendencia.description: We developed a fully conversion-oriented landing page for CPF Sem Pendência, designed to speak directly to an audience facing one of the biggest everyday financial struggles: a negative CPF status.
cpfSemPendencia.body: People with credit restrictions often struggle to get loans, financing, credit cards, installment purchases, and even professional opportunities. With that in mind, we designed an experience that conveys credibility from the very first contact. We combined modern, professional design with UX best practices, creating an intuitive, fast, and objective navigation that minimizes friction throughout the user journey.
